name: Expert Guidance
tagline: A body of instructional material on the user's own difficulty, domain, or skill, divided into discrete pieces and held beside the core activity rather than as a step within it.
desc: Expert guidance is instructional material about the user's own difficulty, domain, or skill, kept apart from the product's core activity so that activity can be completed in full without ever opening it. The distinguishing question is what the user knows afterward: how to operate the product, or something about their own situation that would remain true without it, a finance app explaining how to set a budget in its own interface is a tutorial, the same app explaining how compound interest works is this. The material can be written by an outside expert or the product's own team, sit inside the app or on an external site, and run as a flat library or an ordered course, none of which changes whether it qualifies. What does change the classification is whether working through the material is itself the core activity: where it is, as in a dedicated learning product, the material is the service rather than something offered beside it.
principle: The product doesn't need the material to be opened for it to do its job. A library addressing the user's own difficulty, sitting beside the core activity rather than gating it, signals that the product understands the problem whether or not any single piece is ever read.
warn: The label is easy to misapply in both directions. Toward the product's own tutorial library, walkthrough series, or feature academy, none of which teach the user's underlying difficulty however many videos it has or however credentialed its presenter, and toward instruction folded into the core activity itself, a coaching line mid-workout or a tutorial gating the next step, which is the activity or onboarding rather than material offered beside it. The test in both directions is what the user would still know if the product disappeared.
variants: Ordered course, pieces are arranged into a defined sequence with a stated beginning, body, and summary
Contextually placed guidance, the product surfaces a relevant piece where its subject arises in the product, while the piece remains part of a standing library
Personalized guidance, the product selects or orders the material according to the user's account, stated needs, history, or product state
Gated guidance, part or all of the material sits behind a purchase, plan, or eligibility condition
lifecycle: Effective from the very first use, since the material doesn't depend on any account history or accumulated activity. Its actual pull depends on something the product doesn't control: whether the user's underlying difficulty is live enough at that moment to make opening a library feel worth it.
